CustomField.description: Formula field use to concatenate the Subscription Start Date and Subscription End Date so that we can use the field on the Right Rail Related List
CustomField.formula:
TEXT(MONTH(Subscription_Start_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(DAY(Subscription_Start_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(Subscription_Start_Date__c)) & " to " & TEXT(MONTH(Subscription_End_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(DAY(Subscription_End_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(Subscription_End_Date__c))
/*TEXT(Subscription_Start_Date__c) & " to " & TEXT(Subscription_End_Date__c)*/
CustomField.label: CPQ Dates
